tokenizer_audit.notes: Causal SMILES GPT-2 (ZINC, BPE); requires explicit <s> BOS prefix (interior CE 1.08 vs 3.92 without BOS).

valence_activation_patching.note: Governing-atom element substitution (C -> O) flips remaining valence across the >=2 double-bond legality boundary without introducing illegal SMILES syntax. Because GPT-2 BPE merges ')' + '=' into a single token ')=', long-range branch-spanning pairs (tok_gap >= 10) naturally contrast logit(')=') - logit(')'), while non-branch near pairs contrast standalone logit('=') - logit('C'). Both are reported.
